en.title: Contiguous Subarrays with Product Not Exceeding a Threshold
en.description:
Count the non-empty contiguous subarrays whose product of elements does not exceed k; the comparison includes equality.

This site independently prepared the standard I/O and the solution; supplements for bounds missing from the source and corrections to examples are stated explicitly in the protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n, the second line contains n positive integers, and the third line contains k. The original OCR is authoritative: 1≤n≤500000, 1≤a[i]≤100, 1≤k≤1000000; the smaller n and larger k in the source's summary chapter do not override the OCR.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 4; 4; 6. Verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Use a sliding window over positive numbers: after adding the right end, shrink the left end until the product is ≤k, then add the current window length.
